pages.title: The hot summer · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm September evening in Phoenix. The sun goes down behind the hills. Ivy sits on a bench in the park. Her neighbor Marco comes with cold juice. They talk about the last summer. Ivy starts the talk.
“Hi, Marco! Last summer was hotter than this summer.” says Ivy. “Yes! July was the hottest month of the year.” says Marco. “What did you do on those hot days?” says Ivy.
